run_testSQ: run the TestSQ unit tests to validate GPU IVF scalar quantizer index behavior across quantizer types
test_make_indices_copy_from_cpu: test the make_indices_copy_from_cpu function to create GPU IVF SQ indices from a trained CPU index
test_make_indices_copy_from_gpu: test the make_indices_copy_from_gpu function to train a GPU IVF SQ index and copy it back to CPU
test_compare_results: test the compare_results function to count index differences between CPU and GPU search results
test_do_multi_test: test the do_multi_test function to run IVF SQ tests across multiple dimensions and metrics
